problem.title: How to do code generation with modern Python packaging?
problem.description: I've been trying to wrap my head around modern Python packaging, and one of the things I still can't find anything clear about is how to do build-time codegen (so e.g. in-source data files get compiled to code file during build, and those code files get packaged in the sdist or wheel).
